title: Personal Website Portfolio Template
description: A clean, professional personal website and portfolio template designed for freelancers, designers, developers, and creative professionals to showcase their work and skills. The template features a centered hero section with name, title, and brief bio with professional headshot. Below the fold, a skills section highlights expertise with icon-labeled categories and proficiency bars or tags. The work/portfolio section uses a clean grid of project thumbnails with hover overlays showing project titles and categories. Each project expands to a detail page with description, client, role, timeline, and gallery. The about section includes a more detailed bio, work experience timeline, education, and testimonials from clients. Contact section has a simple form and social media links. The design is highly focused on the individual's personal brand with customizable colors and fonts. Clean, minimal aesthetic with generous whitespace. Typography pairs a display font for the hero name with clean sans-serif throughout. Built with Figma auto-layout. The template is fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
primary_use_case: Perfect for freelancers, designers, developers, and creative professionals needing a clean personal portfolio website with project showcases and client testimonials.
style_vibe: Clean, professional personal brand portfolio with blue accent and generous whitespace — optimized for freelancers and creative professionals.
